title: iRacing New M2 Racing Summit Point Guide 1:20.4 BMW M2 Racing G87 Summit Point Track Guide Fixed

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: braking marker into turn one, four cones on the left, 55% and trail off
corners.line: turn-in to braking marker, apex less important, get on gas early
corners.exit: full throttle exit, plenty of room

corners.braking: grass patch, lift and brake to 18-20%
corners.exit: full throttle exit, touch gravel trap on right

corners.spoken_as: little notch in the tire wall

corners.braking: brake at four cone on left, initially 50%, then 56%
brake to 18% at grass bit, trail off
corners.line: miss left kerb, slight kiss to left curbing
corners.exit: get back on gas briefly, lift off, brake to 60% at apex

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: drop it down to fourth and then to third
corners.line: trail it off and then pick back up on the gas at the apex

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: briefly on the brakes to about 25%
corners.exit: pick back up on the gas

corners.line: get all the way down to the inside
corners.exit: pick back up on the gas

corners.braking: get on the brakes to about 40%
corners.exit: pick back up on the gas just ahead of the apex
full gas just ahead of apex

general_tips: Use engine braking to slow down
ensure track temp shown at bottom right of dashboard is correct
First couple of laps, you might need to do a little lift through there.
